responsibility: This file provides out-of-line HOST_WIDE_INT arithmetic helpers and fallback bit-operation implementations for older bootstrap compilers. Beyond compatibility versions of log2/bit-count routines, it defines checked greatest-common-divisor, least-common-multiple, and overflow-asserting multiplication helpers used by host-side integer calculations throughout GCC.
same_name_distinction: Supplies out-of-line HOST_WIDE_INT helper implementations, including bootstrap-compiler fallbacks for bit operations and checked arithmetic helpers like gcd, mul_hwi, and least_common_multiple. The header establishes the integer types/macros and provides the normal inline bit/arithmetic utilities.
